title: Page 61
transc:
(no 2)  10 pm 
Buckley  Wash Apl 30. 1864.
N. Orleans La ---- 
Hunter Ogden Apl Reliance for Lapland & nutmeg
---- Crowd directs that orders heretofore given be 
so modified that no wharf be with drawn
from operations against Shreveport & on Altar Wafer
and that operations there be continued under the
Senior officer in Prospect until further orders wiley 
lady Chf Staff Copy sent nutmeg via Little Rock


(No 9)  10 PM
Capt Clowry  Wash Apl 30th 1864 
Little Rock Ark.
Pagan Apl 30th Susan for amen
& Vernon Steele ---- vomit vermin
Bangor directs that orders heretofore given
be so modified that no youth
be with drawn from operations against
Shreveport & on Glover Spartan &
that operations there be continued under
the senior officer in command until
further orders signed applause Chf Staff
Copy sent Amen via Cairo End
